A little red fox sitting beside a boy, the boy is fishing by the river at sunset with his back turned to us, holding an antique fishing rod. The fox gazes at the serene lake, surrounded by gentle water ripples. The background showcases vibrant grasslands on both sides of the riverbank, boats docked along the edges, and majestic distant mountains bathed in warm, golden light. Rendered in anime style with flat illustrations and bright, vivid colors, created using digital painting techniques. The scene exudes a dreamy, romantic, magical, and cinematic atmosphere. High resolution, intricate details, sharp focus, inspired by Atey Ghailan and Studio Ghibli aesthetics.
